dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea - Earthquake on Feb 21 2026
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000saks](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000saks) Magnitude 5.7 earthquake at 71.612 depth occurred on Feb 21 2026 16km SE of Madang. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -5.3681 longitude 145.8345. It impacted 79462 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
